role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write a one-page privacy sheet that every staff member reads and signs. It is a draft for Anthony and for Catherine to check; it is not legal advice.

inline_inputs.label: Who sees what (GRACE-R22-PART-6.md section 4, CATHERINE-R22B-PART-6.md)
inline_inputs.text:
Midwife on duty: flags yes, clinical record yes, delete no. Phlebotomists (GTT Medical): flags yes, test day record only, delete no. Venue manager (Lounge): flags only, no clinical record, delete no. Lounge and service staff: nothing. System administrator: flags yes, record only to restore and logged, delete yes and logged. Anthony's administrator role is an open issue; until it is cleared the administrator login belongs to a named GTT Medical manager. Every look at a record is logged by name and time. The partner lab gets nothing from this system; the paper request travels with the sample.
Because GTT is a pregnancy glucose test service, even a name on a GTT list or a GTT voicemail is health information, because it tells a reader she is pregnant and being tested. Day list: first name and surname initial, Draw 1 time and staff first names only; locked drawer; shredded at the end of the test day with a log line. No home printing, no photos of any list or record. No health words in any note, subject line, text preview or timesheet; record a code only. Voicemails and follow-up messages say only Please call us. Reviews: never reply in a way that confirms she was a client; use general words: Thank you for your feedback. Please contact us on {phone}. A lost list or record is a possible data breach: tell Grace the same day.

deliverable.format: A one-page sheet. Section A: why privacy matters here (3 lines). Section B: a table of 5 rows (role, flags, clinical record, can delete). Section C: ten Do and Do not rules, one line each. Section D: if something goes wrong, 4 lines. Section E: a signature line for the staff member.
deliverable.write_only: the five sections and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: legal advice, a statute citation not in the inputs, a phone number, a health detail

extra_checks: The table matches the inputs exactly and the venue manager row says flags only.
The rules include no photos, no health words in notes, shredding at the end of the test day and the review reply wording.
